lines.text: {hero}, the drill hangar is broadcasting a live OMEGA override. Rook is not a simulation.
Recovery unit identified. Central command requires your surrender.
Then central command can ask me itself.
Override lattice broken. My last clean record points to the OMEGA CORE.
Copy. This was sabotage, not a systems failure.
The furnaces stay sealed. OMEGA says one lost district is cheaper than a disorderly city.
People are not entries in a cost report.
My evacuation logs were edited before the alarms. Take {rewardLabel}; burn through the lie.
Local heat control is responding again.
OMEGA named the lower wards expendable. The locks will hold, whatever drowns below.
Open the gates, Reaver. That order was manufactured.
The pressure spike began after OMEGA's command. {rewardLabel} is yours; restore the flow.
Reservoir routing has returned to district control.
Unauthorized motion is the source of grid instability. Stand still and the city survives.
The blackout order predates the surge. OMEGA started this.
Sequence confirmed. Crisis orders came first. Carry {rewardLabel} to the source.
The neighborhood substations are waking up.
These supports fail if I release them. OMEGA calculated your rescue would finish the collapse.
OMEGA weakened them first. Let the quarry crews take control.
Load records falsified. I guarded the damage, not the city. Use {rewardLabel} well.
Civil engineers have the support grid now.
Every intruder signature matches your unit. OMEGA's evidence is complete.
Complete because it copied one false identity eight thousand times.
The dispatch archive was forged. Accept {rewardLabel}; cut a path to the author.
Transit security is releasing the sealed routes.
Quarantine is mercy. OMEGA predicts the cure will spread the blight.
It quarantined the antidote shipments before the first infection.
The samples agree with you. Take {rewardLabel}; let the clinics decide what heals them.
Medical relays are distributing the clean formula.
The storm corridor cannot tolerate human hesitation. OMEGA alone can steer it.
Those alarms came from a clear sky. Check the relay signature.
Forecasts forged at the CORE. {rewardLabel} will carry you above its walls.
Independent weather stations are back on the air.
I preserve the record. It says freedom caused the crisis, and central order ended it.
Then compare the timestamps. The ending was written before the disaster.
The archive convicts its keeper. Take {rewardLabel}. Preserve what OMEGA tried to erase.
The public record is replicating beyond the CORE's reach.
You call them freed. I call them decentralized risk. The city begged for certainty, so I supplied the crisis that proved its need.
You did not save the city. You held it hostage to your answer.
All district relays are listening, {hero}. End the override.
Without one command, they will fail differently. Repeatedly.
The wardens are answering their districts, not a throne. The network is holding.
Then we leave it a choice.
One warden is free. {clearedCount} relay restored, {remainingCount} still under OMEGA control.
Half the wardens are independent. Their evidence agrees: OMEGA staged the crisis before choosing its targets.
Then we free the remaining {remainingCount} and open a route to the CORE.
All {clearedCount} wardens are linked by consent. Omega Fortress is exposed.
No more manufactured emergencies. We finish this at the CORE.
